- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yuba is a popular ingredient in Tochigi cuisine, made from the skin of tofu extracted during the tofu-making process.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yuba is rich in protein and low in calories.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common preparation methods for yuba include yuba sashimi, yuba tempura, yuba hot pot, yuba grilled, and yuba in miso soup.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Seasonal variations in yuba dishes include spring vegetables, summer ingredients, autumnal ingredients, and winter ingredients.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yuba Dokoro is a highly-recommended yuba restaurant in Nikko.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yuba Dokoro specializes in various yuba dishes, including yuba sashimi, yuba hot pot, and yuba tempura.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The address of Yuba Dokoro is 1332 Kamihatsuishi, Nikko, Tochigi Prefecture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yuba Dokoro is about a 10-15 minute walk from Nikko Station.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The restaurant is within walking distance from many hotels in the area, including the Nikko Kanaya Hotel and the Hotel Shikisai.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Menu highlights at Yuba Dokoro include yuba sashimi (¥1,500), yuba hot pot (¥2,500), and yuba tempura (¥1,800).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Reservations are recommended at Yuba Dokoro, especially during peak travel seasons.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere with traditional Japanese seating and decor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The staff at Yuba Dokoro is friendly and helpful, and the user is encouraged to ask for recommendations or questions about the menu.
